summary: AggregateOp StrEnum (sum/min/max/product — all four now implemented) and Aggregate Pydantic model (column_name + operation) describing an accumulator accumulation column.
lifecycle_notes: min/max/product aggregate operations added (feature A2, PR #51) — the prior profile's coverage.md flagged 'only sum is implemented' as an open question; that gap is now closed.
Documented limitation retained: aggregate-value overflow is backend-defined and unguarded (only __prime_product identity is int64-guarded); product overflows fastest.
